query_text: unable to build nests or care for their young

messages.content: unable to build nests or care for their young

message.content:
The phrase most likely refers to a species that is **incapable of building a nest or caring for its young**, as some birds rely on other strategies instead of parental care in a nest. One well-known example is the **cuckoo**, which lays its eggs in other birds’ nests and leaves the host birds to raise the young; by contrast, many birds do build nests and care for their chicks themselves.[1][3][6]

If you meant a **crossword clue** or **definition**, the likely answer is **“brood parasite”** or **“cuckoo”** depending on the exact wording and number of letters.[1][3]
